title: A Joomla page.create reply uses the new menu item's URL and keeps its path when the home read is stale
steps: From the repository root run: pnpm --filter @tracy/dsh-site-tools exec node --test test/page-create.test.mjs
Read the result of the named Joomla routing test and the suite fail count.
expect: The Joomla routing test passes: when an older menu item has the same label, page.create accepts the new item's absolute same-site href https://example.com/index.php/common-questions and verifies /index.php/common-questions.
The Joomla stale-home test passes: when the home read lacks the new item, page.create retains /en/common-questions and verifies that path.
The test suite exits 0 with 0 failures.

selectors.test: Joomla: the reported page path follows the new menu item href when labels repeat and SEF rewriting is off

evidence: Issue #1302: on Joomla with URL rewriting off, the agent returned a bare SEF path that 404ed while the site's menu link using /index.php/<slug> returned 200.
fence: The page-create host flow and its rendered-menu href selection over an injected Joomla page reader. Not exercised: a live Joomla site's anonymous HTTP route behavior.

tests: Joomla: the reported page path follows an absolute same-site menu href when labels repeat and SEF rewriting is off
Joomla: a missing new menu item in the home read does not discard its created path
